nodes.text: Photographers, Pattern Tuesday 📸📸📸 This playground floor is just a grid of little holes and I can't stop looking at it. Find me a pattern - repeating, hypnotic, accidental, whatever. ONE photo. Replying is consent: 3 favorites featured tomorrow, pin to my profile, and standouts may land in a weekend IG roundup with full credit.
photos: A macro shot of a blue, perforated playground platform covered in morning dew, with blurred red and blue playground equipment in the background.

replies.text: Spider Web
photos: A dewy spiderweb gleams in the morning sun, intricately spun between tall blades of grass against a soft, dark background.

A low-angle, eye-level, close-up shot focuses on a series of triangular metal handles connected to overhead monkey bars in a playground, captured in grayscale. The handles recede from the center into the background, creating a perspective that looks down the length of the parallel bars.

replies.text: *shot on iPhone
photos: An overhead, high-angle view showcases rows of charming brick brownstones in a dense urban neighborhood, with a light dusting of snow on their dark roofs. Bare trees line a street in the middle ground, separating the residential blocks and adding a touch of winter atmosphere to the scene.

A collection of heavy, weathered metal gears with distinct spiral teeth interlocks in a complex mechanical arrangement, bathed in a warm, amber-toned light. The close-up perspective emphasizes the industrial texture and intricate design of the machinery, creating a dramatic and textured composition.

A tall residential building features a striking facade with undulating, wave-like balconies made of copper-toned metal, contrasting against a clear blue sky.

replies.text: Those balconies look like the building is doing the wave. Front row seats for the whole street.
And the view of the lake too.
Bottles of wine on a rack
photos: A mesmerizing close-up shows a large matrix of glowing blue lights arranged in three distinct sections against a black background, creating an abstract, futuristic geometric pattern.

replies.text: A whole grid of glowing blue bottles. This is what a wine cellar dreams about.

photos: A close-up shot fills the frame with a bowl of golden-brown caramel corn, glistening under a warm light. The rich, glossy coating on every piece creates an irresistible invitation for a cozy movie night.

replies.text: A mountain of popcorn with zero structural integrity and I respect that.
Don’t forget zero health benefits too 😉 (they were doused in a decadent sweet caramel melted floss)
Reynolds Aluminum building in Southfield, Michigan.
photos: A low-angle, medium shot shows two panels of a building exterior with round, gold, geometric patterns that resemble leaves overlapping one another, and metallic framing against a cloudy sky.

replies.text: Those interlocking rings look like Olympic medals had a baby with a sunshade. Mid-century showing off.

photos: A light green plastic light switch is set against a matching light green textured fabric wall with a woven-in darker green rectangle pattern. The switch, oriented vertically, has an ivory-colored toggle that is down. The light switch plate is held in place by two flat-head screws, one at the top and one at the bottom, matching the switch plate color.

replies.text: The wallpaper had a whole pattern going and the light switch still stole the show.
